$comment: What `otta strip <key>` removes from this app beyond the wiring `otta add` wrote: the files and folders that exist only for the key, the npm dependencies only it uses, and the keys that cannot stay without it. Lines inside shared files are marked `otta:only <key>` / `otta:begin <key> … otta:end <key>` instead. `otta add <key> <other-app>` copies these paths from here. See packages/cli/README.md, Stripping.

demo.description: The demo gallery, the docs pages, the marketing home page, the demo API routes, the Todo sample model, the seed content and the public-demo deployment.

ottablog.description: The blog, the changelog and the studio: pages, admin pages, worker routes, SEO and theme injection.

comments.description: Comments on blog posts. Their security context resolves the post, so they go with the blog.

ottalanding.description: The landing site editor and its worker routes.

shortlinks.description: Short URLs with edge click tracking: the admin page and the worker routes.

referrals.description: Referral links and attribution: the dashboard, the tracker, the page, the worker routes.

ottaai.description: OttaAI: provider keys, the gateway page, the completion route. Meters its spend, so it needs meter.

meter.description: Usage metering. Composition only; OttaAI depends on it.

postmaster.description: Inbound mail, suppressions and unsubscribe links. Composition plus the Worker's email handler.

legal.description: The legal pages and the config they render from.

alerts.description: Operator alerts: the admin page and the end-to-end wiring test.

vault.description: Backups to R2: the admin page. Fleet reports the newest backup through it.

fleet.description: The fleet report for Tower. Composition only.

screenshot.description: Screenshots through Browser Rendering. Composition only.

og.description: Social images through Browser Rendering: the composition, and the blog's card for posts without a hero image.

webhooks.description: Outbound webhooks (Premium): the admin page and the quota adapter. The Durable Object stays: it is generic.
